# Layer kinds

What a composition's `layers` can hold. `turbomotion comp catalogue` prints the same data as JSON.

## `solid`

A flat rectangle: backgrounds, flashes, mattes. Size defaults to the composition.

```json
{
  "color": "#101828",
  "type": "solid"
}
```

## `text`

Text with real shaping. `font` is a family or a file; `align` left|center|right (the layer's pos is the alignment edge, vertically centred); `width` wraps. Characters the designed font does not have take a fallback face and are painted in the same colour as the rest of the line. `preset` is a named per-character animation (see `text_presets`); `animators` build your own (GSAP staggers or After Effects range selectors). `text` can also be a counter {from, to, at, dur, ease, decimals, sep, prefix, suffix}.

```json
{
  "align": "center",
  "color": "#ffffff",
  "font": "Avenir Next",
  "mark": {
    "at": 1.0,
    "word": "move"
  },
  "pos": [
    960,
    540
  ],
  "preset": {
    "at": 0.3,
    "name": "reveal"
  },
  "role": "title",
  "text": "Make it move\nlike you mean it",
  "type": "text",
  "weight": 800
}
```

## `image`

Your own picture. `fit` cover|contain|fill|none, `focus` keeps the subject when cropping, `camera` is a Ken Burns move {from: {zoom, center}, to, ease}, `parallax` {depth: <grey image, white = near>, strength} gives a 2.5D move. `sampling` nearest|linear overrides automatic cubic enlargement / mipmapped reduction. EXIF orientation is applied. Size the source to at least the pixels shown (check warns about upscaling).

```json
{
  "camera": {
    "ease": "sine.inOut",
    "from": {
      "center": [
        0.45,
        0.5
      ],
      "zoom": 1.0
    },
    "to": {
      "center": [
        0.6,
        0.5
      ],
      "zoom": 1.3
    }
  },
  "fit": "cover",
  "focus": [
    0.6,
    0.5
  ],
  "src": "photo.jpg",
  "type": "image"
}
```

## `video`

A video file streamed through ffmpeg. `src_in` starts into the file, `speed`, `loop`, `fit`, `size`; its sound is mixed unless `mute`. Combine with masks and mattes for rounded or shaped clips.

```json
{
  "loop": true,
  "mute": true,
  "size": [
    640,
    360
  ],
  "src": "clip.mp4",
  "type": "video"
}
```

## `audio`

A sound on the timeline: `volume` (a property), `fade_in`, `fade_out`, `src_in`, `speed`. Mixed in Rust (soft-clipped) and muxed into the render. Other layers can react: `amp("id")` is its loudness, `onset("id")` spikes on hits.

```json
{
  "fade_out": 1.0,
  "id": "music",
  "src": "music.wav",
  "type": "audio",
  "volume": 0.8
}
```

## `mesh`

A solid: a triangle mesh from a `geometry` generator, lit by the composition's lights (ambient, point, spot, directional; `material` sets specular and shininess) and drawn through its camera. Needs "three_d": true. Geometry kinds: `text` (glyph outlines extruded, with an optional chamfer; one layer per letter to stagger a word), `box`, `sphere`, `torus`, `cylinder` (`top: 0` makes a cone) and `extrude` (an SVG path pushed into depth). It turns about its own middle, so `rot_x` / `rot_y` / `rotation` tumble or spin it (`"rot_y": "time*90"` is a turntable). `color` is the front and a curved skin, `side` the walls, `back` the back; `side` defaults to a darkened `color`.

```json
{
  "color": "#e8402f",
  "geometry": {
    "bevel": 6,
    "depth": 60,
    "font": "Avenir Next",
    "kind": "text",
    "size": 300,
    "text": "M",
    "weight": 800
  },
  "material": {
    "shininess": 40,
    "specular": 0.8
  },
  "pos": [
    960,
    540,
    0
  ],
  "rot_x": 20,
  "rot_y": {
    "dur": 0.8,
    "ease": "back.out(1.4)",
    "from": -90,
    "to": 0
  },
  "side": "#8a2017",
  "three_d": true,
  "type": "mesh"
}
```

## `shape`

Vector shapes with fill, gradient, stroke, dashes, trim (draw-on), morph and repeat. Geometry: rect, ellipse, polygon, star, d (SVG path), points.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "fill": {
        "gradient": {
          "from": [
            0,
            -120
          ],
          "stops": [
            [
              0,
              "#ff8a00"
            ],
            [
              1,
              "#e52e71"
            ]
          ],
          "to": [
            0,
            120
          ],
          "type": "linear"
        }
      },
      "radius": 24,
      "rect": [
        -200,
        -120,
        400,
        240
      ]
    },
    {
      "ellipse": [
        0,
        0,
        90,
        90
      ],
      "stroke": {
        "cap": "round",
        "color": "#ffffff",
        "width": 8
      },
      "trim": {
        "end": {
          "at": 0.3,
          "dur": 1,
          "ease": "power3.inOut",
          "from": 0,
          "to": 1
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "pos": [
    960,
    540
  ],
  "type": "shape"
}
```

## `null`

An invisible transform to parent other layers to: one handle moves, scales or shakes a whole group.

```json
{
  "id": "rig",
  "pos": [
    960,
    540
  ],
  "rotation": {
    "dur": 2,
    "ease": "sine.inOut",
    "from": -4,
    "to": 4
  },
  "type": "null"
}
```

## `precomp`

Plays a nested composition from `comps` as one layer, with its own clock (offset, speed, time remap, loop). `sampling` nearest|linear controls transformed pixels (default linear); use nearest for integer-scaled pixel art. Everything a layer can do (effects, masks, mattes, 3D) works on it.

```json
{
  "comp": "inner",
  "pos": [
    960,
    540
  ],
  "scale": {
    "dur": 0.6,
    "ease": "expo.out",
    "from": 0.8,
    "to": 1
  },
  "speed": 1,
  "start": 0.5,
  "type": "precomp"
}
```

## `adjustment`

Applies its effects to everything below it (a grade, a glitch, a blur over the whole picture). Masks limit it to a region; opacity fades it.

```json
{
  "fx": [
    {
      "amount": 4,
      "effect": "chromatic_aberration"
    },
    {
      "effect": "vignette",
      "strength": 0.4
    }
  ],
  "type": "adjustment"
}
```

## `texture`

Paints a generator shader over the layer (noise, clouds, cells, stripes, grid, gradient, light_leak, bokeh, floor, or your own `effects/<name>.sksl` with `@kind generator`). Use it as a background, a matte, or blended over footage. `comp fx list` shows each one's parameters.

```json
{
  "blend": "screen",
  "opacity": 0.6,
  "params": {
    "high": "#9aa7c7",
    "scale": 300
  },
  "shader": "clouds",
  "type": "texture"
}
```

## `particles`

A particle system where every particle is a closed-form function of its age (so any frame renders alone). The emitter sits at the layer's position. Emit continuously (`rate`) and/or in `burst`s; `prewarm` starts it already running. Shapes: soft, circle, square, spark (streak along travel), star, ring. Use blend `add` or `screen` for light.

```json
{
  "angle": -90,
  "blend": "add",
  "colors": [
    [
      0,
      "#ffffff"
    ],
    [
      0.4,
      "#ffd36b"
    ],
    [
      1,
      "#ff4a3d"
    ]
  ],
  "drag": 0.4,
  "gravity": [
    0,
    160
  ],
  "life": [
    1,
    2.5
  ],
  "opacity_over_life": [
    [
      0,
      1
    ],
    [
      0.8,
      1
    ],
    [
      1,
      0
    ]
  ],
  "pos": [
    960,
    900
  ],
  "rate": 90,
  "shape": "spark",
  "size": [
    4,
    10
  ],
  "speed": [
    180,
    420
  ],
  "spread": 40,
  "trail": 3,
  "type": "particles"
}
```

## `pack`

Graphics owned by another crate and registered by the host (a globe, a map, a chart): {"type": "pack", "name": "<pack>", "params": {...}}. `comp catalogue` lists the packs this build has under `packs`. A pack paints a picture from its params and the layer's time; everything else (transform, effects, masks, mattes, 3D) works on it like any layer.

```json
{
  "color": "#000",
  "type": "solid"
}
```

## `camera`

A 3D camera (the topmost active one is used). Layers with "three_d": true are projected through it. Default: 1:1 at z = 0.

```json
{
  "poi": [
    960,
    540,
    0
  ],
  "pos": [
    {
      "dur": 4,
      "ease": "sine.inOut",
      "from": 760,
      "to": 1160
    },
    540,
    -1800
  ],
  "type": "camera",
  "zoom": 1800
}
```

## `light`

A light for 3D layers: ambient, point, directional or spot. 3D layers are shaded by every active light.

```json
{
  "color": "#ffd9a0",
  "intensity": 1.2,
  "kind": "point",
  "pos": [
    400,
    200,
    -500
  ],
  "radius": 1400,
  "type": "light"
}
```

## `extrude`

Depth for a three_d text, shape or solid layer: copies stepping back in z, coloured from `color` to `far`. Show it with a camera move or rot_y.

```json
{
  "extrude": {
    "color": "#7a1d14",
    "depth": 60
  },
  "pos": [
    960,
    540
  ],
  "rot_y": 18,
  "text": "88888",
  "three_d": true,
  "type": "text"
}
```
